## Description

Embeds non-linear market state transitions into an infinite-dimensional linear space using deep Koopman operator theory to linearize chaotic price dynamics for short-horizon forecasting.

## Where it may fit

Intraday high-volatility regime shifts, complex multi-asset price trajectories.

## Vehicles

Advanced quantitative hedge funds, proprietary trading desks.

## Required data

High-frequency limit order book states, multi-asset tick time series.

## Caveats

Requires dictionary function selection for observables; computationally intensive training phase.
